title: Mean squared error
tagline: Average of squared residuals — the default regression loss.
history: Squared error underpins least squares (Legendre 1805, Gauss ~1809); it is the loss whose minimum the normal equations solve in closed form.
useCases: Penalizing big misses more than small ones
Reporting model error in the same units²
whenToUse: Continuous targets where large errors should be punished disproportionately.
whenNotToUse: Classification (use cross-entropy) or data with heavy outliers (consider MAE / Huber).
complexity: O(n) · gradient w.r.t. prediction is 2·(ŷ − y)
